registered_claims.note: Each claim is evaluated independently; the accuracy and token-use results are never combined into one verdict.

accuracy.equivalent: two one-sided tests at alpha 0.05, so the two-sided 90% score interval lies inside [-0.025, +0.025]

token_use.equivalent: not registered; lower token use is a benefit rather than a deviation to bound

expected_precision_at_planned_pairs.note: Two-sided 95% precision scaled from the dev variation to 300 pairs; planning values, not guarantees. The report uses the observed frozen-run uncertainty.

variance_inputs.source: K=3 dev replication, 2026-09-10, recomputed 2026-09-11; re-measure per model

attempt_basis.accuracy: mean per-cell sample variance over the three attempts of each cell
attempt_basis.cost: spread of single-attempt paired log ratios, pooled over the nine ways of pairing one baseline attempt with one treatment attempt; the frozen run is K=1, so a pair carries single-attempt noise rather than the noise of a three-attempt mean

failure_policy.agent_failure: scored as an outcome, counted as a miss
failure_policy.infra_failure: instance excluded when no usable attempt exists in an arm
failure_policy.attempt_selection: latest usable attempt represents the cell
